description.en: Chicken breasts dredged in thyme and flour, browned and served in a mushroom and sherry sauce.
description.he: חזה עוף מצופה בטימין וקמח, מוזהב ומוגש ברוטב פטריות ושרי.

en: Cut up chicken and dredge in thyme and flour.
Add the rest of ingredients until sauce thickens.
he: חותכים את העוף ומצפים בטימין וקמח.
מוסיפים את שאר המרכיבים עד שהרוטב מסמיך.

ocrRawText:
Chicken & Mushrooms
12 oz Mushrooms          4 Chicken Breasts
1/4 tsp Thyme            1/4 c Sherry
Flour &                  Oil
1 can Chicken Broth

Cut up chicken & dredge in thyme & flour. Brown in
oil & remove. Saute Mushrooms in drippings. Add the
rest of ingredients until sauce thickens. Then add
the chicken back

The OCR raw text layout in B also appears more faithful to typical handwritten recipe card formatting with ingredients arranged in columns.
